instruction.text: Höre zu und schreibe das gehörte Wort in die Lücke.

hint.text: Achte auch auf die Leerzeichen zwischen zwei Wörtern.

atoms.b: Hello Carla, do you have ((++some a)) time?
atoms.sound: Hello Carla, do you have some time?

atoms.a: Hi Noah, ich habe nicht viel Zeit, aber wir können reden.
atoms.b: Hi Noah, I don't have ((++much many)) time, but we can talk.
atoms.sound: Hi Noah, I don't have much time, but we can talk.

atoms.a: Brauchst du Hilfe beim Vorbereiten deiner Party?
atoms.b: Do you need ((++any a_few)) help preparing your party?
atoms.sound: Do you need any help preparing your party?

atoms.a: Ja, ich kann Hilfe gebrauchen! Ich brauche noch eine Menge Chips.
atoms.b: Yes, I could use a hand! I still need ((++lots_of some)) crisps.
atoms.sound: Yes, I could use a hand! I still need lots of crisps.

atoms.a: Perfekt, wir haben viele Chips vom Geburtstag meiner Mutter übrig. Ich kann sie zur Party mitbringen.
atoms.b: Perfect, we have ((++lots_of much)) crisps left over from my mother's birthday. I can bring them to the party.
atoms.sound: Perfect, we have lots of crisps left over from my mother's birthday. I can bring them to the party.

atoms.a: Super! Weißt du, wo ich Luftballons kaufen kann? Ich finde zu Hause keine.
atoms.b: Great! Do you know where I can buy balloons? I can't find ((++any many)) at home.
atoms.sound: Great! Do you know where I can buy balloons? I can't find any at home.

atoms.a: Keine Sorge, wir haben auch noch einige Luftballons übrig. Sind acht ausreichend?
atoms.b: Don't worry, we also have ((++some many)) balloons left. Are eight enough?
atoms.sound: Don't worry, we also have some balloons left. Are eight enough?

atoms.a: Ja, acht sind perfekt. Ich will nur ein paar an die Tür und in die Küche hängen.
atoms.b: Yes, eight are perfect. I just want to put up ((++a_few a_lot_of)) at the door and in the kitchen.
atoms.sound: Yes, eight are perfect. I just want to put up a few at the door and in the kitchen.

atoms.b: Is there anything else I can do?
atoms.sound: Is there anything else I can do?

atoms.a: Das ist erstmal alles. Du hast mir sehr geholfen. Vielen Dank!
atoms.b: That's all for now. You helped me ((++a_lot many)). Thank you very much!
atoms.sound: That's all for now. You helped me a lot. Thank you very much!
